name: Inushima Yomi
source:
Uta's younger twin brother, and also a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komainu]komainu[/URL]. He absolutely hates humans, and does his best to not be near them. Yomi has a very cold personality, and barely has any emotions. He tends to find almost everything a total bother. He likes to write songs, and Uta sings them. Yomi also likes to expand his knowledge, so he often reads books.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_yomi.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
